name: LinkKind
declaration: public enum LinkKind : uint
summary: How agents traverse an off-mesh link. Animation reads it from NavAgentState.traversal (an intent), never through a call.

values.name: Walk
values.summary: Straight walk at agent speed (narrow passages, scripted moves).

values.name: Jump
values.summary: Ballistic arc with arc_height; plays a jump animation.

values.name: Ladder
values.summary: Vertical climb at reduced speed; plays a ladder animation.

values.name: Door
values.summary: Passable only while open; agents wait at the start and request opening.

values.name: Elevator
values.summary: Passable only while the cabin is present; riders wait, then ride.
